summary: Documentation-only: adds OpenAPI descriptions to the public API envelope cancel/delete/update routes and their request fields (zod .describe()); no runtime behaviour change.

statements.why: Only route meta description strings and zod .describe() calls changed in packages/trpc/server/envelope-router/*.types.ts; validation and handlers are unchanged. Only the generated public API reference text differs.

misses.what: The public API reference now shows descriptions for the envelope cancel, delete and update endpoints and their fields.
